remarks: Make yourself at home in this charming & ideally located cape. Inviting entry flows seamlessly into sunny & generously-sized living room. Kitchen completely refreshed, featuring quartz countertops w/bespoke waterfall finish & brand-new gas range & refrigerator. Kitchen opens to bright sunroom/dining room/playroom (you decide!) w/beautiful sliders & picture windows overlooking deck & backyard. Step outside & enjoy plenty of greenspace for play along w/the extraordinary deck - perfect for grilling, entertaining or just relaxing. Inside, both main level BRs feature 2 window exposures, ample closet space & easy access to the modernized FBA. Other highlights include hardwood & tile floors throughout, ceiling fans, recessed lighting & coffered & vaulted ceilings. Upstairs, the spacious BR/office options plus 2 floored eaves storage areas provide flexibility. Amazing LL bonus space serves as home gym/playroom/office w/room for storage, too. Pristine laundry room w/sparkling tile backsplash & attached garage make it complete. The carefully thought-out updates, prime location & walkability make this home incredibly special. 1 min to I-95 & under 1/2mi to Chelsea Piers, Rogers School, NBC Sports, HSS, convenience stores & restaurants. 1mi to Cove Island Beach & Park, Cummings Beach & Park & local grocery. 2mi to Downtown Stamford & Stamford RR as well as Noroton Heights retail center & RR makes errands & commuting a breeze. Come take a look at everything this polished gem has to offer!
